key.name: toggle-wechat
key.description: Shows WeChat when it is hidden in the tray, and hides it again when the main window is visible.

key.name: last-geometry
key.summary: Position and size of the WeChat window
key.description: Window geometry as "x,y,width,height". Stored when the window is hidden and applied again when it is shown.

key.name: debug
key.description: Write window and tray activity to the system log. Only useful when reporting a problem.
